known_writer_paths.basis: Native talk/delta and setter fixtures plus direct-call graph.
known_writer_paths.scope: First-talk reward and EventFlow AddFriendship values; the EventFlow inventory proves all 72 configured AddValue arguments reach 0xd34cb0 unchanged.

known_writer_paths.scope: Candidate day-change Friendship adjustment; the -3 branch and ordinary-play reachability remain unexecuted.

direct_writer_inventory.limits: Inventory is based on direct calls and indexed string references in this main.nso build; it cannot rule out indirect writes, dynamic field names, unindexed strings, or code in absent modules.

mail_candidate.friendship_use: 0xabbf00 reads Friendship and converts it with 0xd34a20 while processing a candidate mail/item path; the routine contains no direct 0xf48840 or 0xef2c70 call.
mail_candidate.classification: Read-only with respect to Friendship in the visible pseudocode; exact MAIL_XX_ReMax semantic and any downstream social delta are unproven.

eventflow_gift_related_actions.claim_limit: These are configured action deltas and native callback forwarding. They do not establish every item-quality formula or that each conditional action occurs in a playthrough.

gift_selection.interpretation: NNPC_Select_Present dispatches by selected item kind into creature, equipment, furniture, tool, and other item subflows. NNPC_Select_Sell_Gift is the villager buying a selected player item; CheckNpcFavorLevel selects configured +1/+2/+3 friendship branches, and the overflow branch sends MAIL_XX_OverFlow by NpcMailSendRandom after those deltas. These are different flows from player letters.

player_letter.finding: The local player-to-villager post-office flow edits and posts a message card after a 200-Bell check; it contains no NpcAddFriendship action. The indexed exact-key friendship writer inventory also identifies no letter-sender callsite.
player_letter.limit: This does not rule out a later Friendship change when a delivered letter or attached present is processed.

query_pseudocode.NpcHitNum: 0x388660 returns case 0 when configured Border <= the NPC hit counter; AI_NPC_Normal and AI_NPC_Outdoor use Border=3.
query_pseudocode.NpcIsHitByNet: 0x389c50 returns case 0 when the NPC hit-by-net byte is nonzero.

net_hits.finding: After the hit checks, the AI flows can start NNPC_Talk_Force:Hit. EventFlow events 21, 32, and 33 in the Hit entry configure -3; each follows NoAcquaintance_Chk and CheckNpcLook case 0. NoAcquaintance_Chk exits when HasAcquaintanceship is OFF, so those negative branches require that flag to be ON. The same flow has four other -3 actions in Push and a +5 action in Flea; those are not net-hit branches. Callback forwarding for the configured actions is included in the 72/72 native action test.
limits: Query bodies and AI transition gates are pseudocode evidence, not native execution.
The selected EventFlow dialogue branch is conditional; a net hit does not prove that every hit deducts points.

neglect_and_caps.first_talk_of_day: 0xc84240 increments TalkCountToday and awards Friendship only when its resulting value is 1; the delta is min(ContinuousTalkDays, 3), as pseudocode evidence.
neglect_and_caps.missed_talk: The day-change reset helpers clear ContinuousTalkDays when the prior TalkCountToday is zero in the applicable mode. This removes the streak bonus; no direct Friendship decrement is shown on that path.
neglect_and_caps.field_table: EventFlagsNpcMemoryParam sets Friendship default 25/max 255 and ContinuousTalkDays default 0/max 7. These are field bounds, not an aggregate daily Friendship cap.
neglect_and_caps.milestone_flag: NNPC_Talk_General:PresentAvailable_Chk uses FriendshipBecomeAcqHToday and FriendshipBecomeAcqH to gate ReceivedFirstPresent; these flags are not a writer-level point cap.
neglect_and_caps.quest_timeout: NNPC_Quest_Delivery_TimeOver configures -1, -2, or -3 according to HasDeliveryItem and HasOpenedDeliveryItem query branches; this is a quest timeout penalty, not passive neglect decay.
neglect_and_caps.daily_candidate: The separate 0xf53a70 -> 0xabff90 -> 0xac0200 -> 0xab9dc0 path can supply -3 to a Friendship field write in pseudocode; reachability and its relationship to neglect remain unresolved.
neglect_and_caps.finding: No universal per-day Friendship point cap or passive no-talk point decay is identified by the indexed direct-writer and EventFlow evidence.
